t: High performance oil-free, fat-free silicone spray with instant high gloss. Non-staining, anti-static with excellent high temperature and electrical resistance. Provides a clear barrier to repel water and protect from oxidisation and corrosion. Ideal for treating machinery and moving parts against the build-up of dust, hair and foreign matter. Helps prevent ageing of plastic parts. Rubber parts remain soft and will not freeze, embrittle or stick.
